name: Drutopia Comment
project_description: Drutopia Comment is a config-only "feature" module from the Drutopia distribution. It ships a default node comment type, the comment_body field, form/view displays, an RDF mapping, and config_actions that grant a graduated set of core Comment permissions to the Drutopia roles (anonymous, authenticated, contributor, editor, manager). It contains no PHP: no src/, routes, services, hooks or permissions of its own; commenting behavior and access are core Comment's. Documented from an on-disk DEV checkout (info.yml has no version line); the version directory 2.0.x is the branch, not a tagged release.
